data.title: Field Marketing Manager, DACH
data.description:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems—across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector—co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

Role Summary

As Field Marketing Manager for the DACH region, you will own and execute Mistral’s field marketing strategy, driving brand awareness, demand generation, and revenue growth. You’ll lead the end-to-end planning and delivery of external events, owned events, localized campaigns, ABM initiatives, and partner marketing activities.

This role is ideal for a strategic thinker and hands-on project manager who excels in a collaborative, high-growth environment. Your work will directly advance our mission: delivering frontier AI to the world’s leading organizations to solve their toughest challenges.

What you will do

  • Own the regional field marketing plan and budget for the DACH region aligned to go-to-market objectives.

  • Partner with regional sales leadership to translate territory priorities and target accounts into field marketing programs.

  • Execute the plan of field programs from end-to-end across third-party conference sponsorships, Mistral-owned events (e.g., summits, roundtables, forums), account-Based Marketing (ABM) programs and campaigns.

  • Manage project timelines, vendor relationships, logistics, and speaker coordination with precision.

  • Allocate and optimize the regional marketing budget aligned with field marketing objectives.

  • Monitor and report on progress against objectives and the regional territory plan. Analyze campaign-level results, extract learnings, and iterate on strategies for continuous improvement.

  • Proactively engage with key stakeholders to ensure program success from sales, product marketing, demand gen, comms, public affairs.

About you

  • 5+ years of experience in field marketing, with a focus on owned events, conference sponsorships, partner marketing, and ABM.

  • Enterprise B2B tech background, with a deep understanding of enterprise selling and B2B tech business models.

  • Proven experience managing field marketing programs in the DACH region.

  • Strategic thinker and problem solver, able to translate business needs into actionable field marketing plans.

  • Strong project management skills, with the ability to deliver in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

  • Fluent in German and English.

  • Self-starter mindset: Result-oriented, resourceful, innovative, and intellectually curious.

  • No ego, highly committed, with a growth mindset and the ability to quickly grasp complex topics.

What We Offer

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page.

Privacy Policy

Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy.

data.title: Teamlead Sales Köln (w/m/d)
data.description:
Über Salonkee

Wir bei Salonkee glauben, dass Friseure und Beauty- Expert:innen ihre Zeit mit Handwerk und Kreativität verbringen sollten - nicht mit Zettelwirtschaft. Als eines der am schnellsten wachsenden SaaS-Unternehmen Europas bieten wir Salons eine Komplettlösung: von der smarten Online-Buchung bis hin zu automatisierten Zahlungen.

Wir suchen keine Verwalter, sondern Gestalter. In Köln schlagen wir das nächste Kapitel auf und suchen jemanden, der unser lokales Team nicht nur führt, sondern gemeinsam mit uns wächst.

 

Deine Rolle: Mitmacher, Stratege & Mentor

Du bist das Gesicht von Salonkee in Köln. Deine Aufgabe ist es, ein schlagkräftiges Team aufzubauen und gleichzeitig sicherzustellen, dass wir nah am Kunden bleiben.

  • Teamaufbau & Coaching: Du baust das Team auf ca. fünf Talente aus. Du führst keine Excel-Tabellen, sondern Menschen - durch 1:1s, gemeinsames Training und echtes Feedback.

  • Präsenz im Markt: Du bist kein Büromensch. Du begleitest dein Team zu Terminen vor Ort, unterstützt bei der Kaltakquise und zeigst in Live-Demos, wie Salonkee den Alltag der Salonbesitzer erleichtert.

  • Struktur schaffen: Du organisierst die Woche so, dass dein Team Erfolg haben kann. Du behältst die CRM-Pflege und die Kennzahlen im Blick, um frühzeitig zu sehen, wo wir nachjustieren können.

  • Vorbildfunktion: Gerade am Anfang bist du selbst aktiv im Verkauf tätig. Nicht, um Rekorde zu brechen, sondern um den Markt in Köln im Detail zu verstehen.

 

Das bringst du mit

  • Erfahrung im Außendienst: Du hast 2–4 Jahre Erfahrung im Vertrieb (idealerweise B2B) gesammelt und weißt, wie man Türen öffnet.

  • Lust auf Führung: Du musst noch kein „Director“ gewesen sein, aber du hast das Talent, andere zu motivieren und Verantwortung für gemeinsame Ziele zu übernehmen.

  • Strukturierte Arbeitsweise: Du planst deine Region eigenständig und weißt, wie man Prioritäten setzt.

  • Kommunikation: Du sprichst fließend Deutsch und kannst dich sicher auf Englisch mit unserem internationalen Team austauschen.

  • Mobilität: Für die Termine bei unseren Partnern vor Ort ist ein Führerschein notwendig.

 

Warum Salonkee?

  • Sicherheit & Erfolg: Ein attraktives Gehaltspaket aus Fixum & Provision, das deine Leistung wirklich belohnt.

  • Dein Firmenwagen: Auch zur privaten Nutzung - damit du immer flexibel bleibst.

  • Freiraum: Wir vertrauen dir. Deine Arbeitszeit gestaltest du so, wie es für dich und dein Team am besten passt.

  • Echte Benefits: 50 € monatliches Guthaben (steuerfrei) via Probonio für deine persönlichen Bedürfnisse sowie regelmäßige Teamevents, die diesen Namen auch verdienen.

     

Klingt nach deinem nächsten Schritt? Wir machen es kurz: Schick uns deinen Lebenslauf. Wir freuen uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen und gemeinsam Köln zu erobern!

data.title: Account Executive (DACH)
data.description:
About SINGU

At SINGU, we’re redefining how the world’s most ambitious real estate companies run their operations. Our mission is to become Europe’s leading platform for managing warehouse, logistics, retail, and multi-site commercial real estate portfolios — empowering our Clients to protect revenue, boost efficiency, and unlock new value across every aspect of their business.

 

Our unified CAFM platform already powers the daily operations of over 250 million m² of real estate worldwide, supporting more than 500,000 professionals. Following our union with the UK’s Micad and Germany’s net-haus, we now help manage 100,000+ buildings across 35+ countries — and we’re just getting started.

 

Backed by a leading growth equity investor, we’re scaling rapidly and partnering with global leaders such as Prologis, ECE, CTP, Hillwood, Logicor, GLP, and Unibail-Rodamco-Westfield. As we continue to grow through strategic acquisitions and bold innovation, we stay true to our core values: adaptability, collaboration, and client focus.

 

If you’re ready to help build Europe’s leading platform for property operations — and make a tangible impact on how the real estate industry works — join SINGU and be part of this transformation.

The Opportunity

This is a pure new business role. You own a defined territory and named-account set, the pipeline you create within it, and the commercial outcome of every deal you run, from first conversation to signature.

The deals are consequential rather than transactional: multi-stakeholder, multi-site, six to nine months, with typical initial values of £25k- £100k and clear multi-country expansion potential. Winning takes a business case, not a demonstration and it requires strong discovery, quantified value, access to senior decision-makers and the ability to align stakeholders across operations, real estate, procurement, IT and finance.

Singu supports complex property and facilities operations across more than 250 million square metres, with established customers spanning commercial real estate, logistics, retail, facility management and the public sector. You will enter deals with credible enterprise references, a proven product and senior executive support, not an unproven proposition.

Why Strong Sellers Join Singu

  • A defined territory and named-account set, not an undifferentiated geographic patch.

  • Enterprise deals with meaningful initial value and clear multi-country expansion potential.

  • Dedicated business development, Pre-Sales, marketing and executive sponsorship.

  • Direct access to the CRO for deal strategy, coaching and fast commercial decisions. Pricing, terms and sponsorship all take place without a committee.

  • Uncapped earnings with meaningful accelerators for over-performance.

  • Credible routes into strategic or global accounts or sales leadership.

What You Will Own

Pipeline and Coverage

  • A new business quota, and a territory plan that shows how you intend to hit it.

  • Pipeline built through business development, marketing, partner and self-generated activity, with personal responsibility for coverage across the territory.

  • Diagnostic conversations grounded in operating cost, compliance and risk.

Deal Execution

  • Opportunities qualified to a MEDDICC standard, with a quantified business case and access to the economic buyer.

  • Every material deal multi-threaded, so it survives a change of sponsor.

  • Commercial negotiation that builds value and protects price rather than defaulting to discount.

  • Rigorous qualification and early decisions on opportunities that lack a credible business case, buying process or route to decision.

Land and Expand

  • First wins scoped so they can grow: sites, countries and use cases sequenced from the start.

  • A clean handover to Customer Success, with the expansion path documented.

Forecasting and Governance

  • A forecast that holds, with stage integrity, next steps and close dates you stand behind.

  • Risk surfaced early, with an honest view of what changed and what is needed.

  • Contribution to the playbook i.e. objections, competitive intelligence and repeatable use cases.

What Excellent Performance Looks Like

Commercial outcomes

  • New-logo ARR against quota

  • Pipeline creation and territory coverage

  • Win rate, against incumbents and against no decision

  • Average deal value and total multi-year value

  • Strategic logos won

Operating standards

  • Forecast accuracy and stage integrity

  • Multi-threading and MEDDICC quality

  • Price protection and discount discipline

  • CRM quality and process discipline

Your First 12 Months

  • First 90 days: complete onboarding, build the territory and account plan, establish pipeline coverage and create the first qualified opportunities.

  • By six months: credible coverage against ramped quota, multi-threaded opportunities progressing through evaluation, and a first customer win closed or materially advanced.

  • By 12 months: delivery against ramped quota, a repeatable pipeline-creation motion in your territory, and accounts landed with clear expansion potential.

What We’re Looking For

  • Typically five or more years in B2B software or complex technology sales, including a sustained period carrying a new business quota. Quality of results matters more than years.

  • Evidence of sustained over-performance in new business sales: quota attainment, team ranking, pipeline personally created and representative deals won. We will ask for specifics.

  • The ability to take us through significant deals end to end: how the opportunity was created, how the buying group developed, what changed, and why it was won or lost.

  • English and German languages at business level. Hard requirement.

  • A structured seller: MEDDICC or comparable, used in practice.

  • Strong results combined with the forecast and CRM discipline to run a predictable business.

  • CAFM, IWMS, FM, PropTech or multi-site operations experience is an advantage.

Package, Support and Progression

  • Competitive base salary uncapped commission, accelerators for over-performance.

  • Business development coverage, Pre-Sales, marketing and enablement to support your success

  • Structured onboarding, methodology training and deal coaching, with a fairly ramped quota.

  • Progression into a global accounts or sales leadership. We back elite individual contributors as readily as future managers.

This role is for an accomplished new business seller who wants the autonomy to build a territory, the support to win complex enterprise deals and real reward for over-performance. If you have created pipeline, won meaningful customers and run a disciplined process, we would like to hear from you.

If this role sounds like a good fit, we’d love to hear from you. Apply and help us build technology that supports critical operations every day.

Compensation: €5K – €5.8K per month • Offers Commission

data.title: Recruiting Consultant (m/w/d)
data.description:
Als Recruiting Consultant bei PowerUs baust du einen neuen Geschäftsbereich von Grund auf mit auf – nicht als kleines Side-Projekt, sondern mit echtem Ownership.

Du übernimmst die Kunden, die unser Sales-Team gewonnen hat, und bist ab dem Closing ihr zentraler Ansprechpartner. Du führst das Onboarding durch, bringst die Stellen live, optimierst sie laufend und screenst die eingehenden Bewerbungen für deine Firmen. Dabei stehst du im permanenten Austausch mit den Unternehmen und baust starke Beziehungen zu beiden Seiten auf – zu den Firmen genauso wie zu den Kandidaten.

💼 Deine Aufgaben

Kunden & Onboarding

  • Du übernimmst neue Kunden direkt vom Sales-Team und wirst ab dem Closing ihr zentraler Ansprechpartner.

  • Du führst das Onboarding durch: Du verstehst den konkreten Hiring-Bedarf und richtest die Zusammenarbeit sauber auf.

  • Du postest die Stellenanzeigen, bringst sie live und optimierst sie laufend anhand von Performance und Feedback.

  • Du stehst im permanenten Kontakt mit den Firmen, gibst regelmäßig Updates und entwickelst die Zusammenarbeit zu langfristigen Partnerschaften weiter.

Bewerbungen & Kandidaten

  • Du screenst die eingehenden Bewerbungen und bewertest Motivation, Erfahrung und Passung für die jeweilige Firma.

  • Du führst Qualifizierungsgespräche und bereitest überzeugende Kandidatenprofile inklusive CV und Summary auf.

  • Du präsentierst passende Kandidaten beim Kunden und steuerst Follow-ups.

  • Du baust gute Beziehungen zu beiden Seiten auf und begleitest den Prozess bis zur Vertragsunterschrift.

Prozess & Aufbau

  • Du steuerst deine Prozesse eigenständig im CRM und hältst alle Schritte sauber nach.

  • Du bringst Struktur in deine Pipeline, priorisierst konsequent und treibst Prozesse aktiv voran.

  • Du baust mit uns Prozesse, Tools und Arbeitsweisen von Grund auf auf – mit dem Ziel, einen neuen Geschäftsbereich skalierbar zu machen.

🙌 Was du mitbringst

  • Du hast Freude daran viel zu kommunizieren - sowohl mit Fachkräften als auch mit Unternehmen

  • Du arbeitest strukturiert und sorgfältig

  • Du hast Lust etwas neues aufzubauen

  • Sehr gutes Deutsch und gutes Englisch.

💪 Benefits

  • Wettbewerbsfähiges Gehalt inklusive Mitarbeiterbeteiligung.

  • 30 Urlaubstage pro Jahr.

  • 1.500 € jährliches Weiterbildungsbudget für Kurse, Konferenzen oder Fachliteratur.

  • Zuschuss für Urban Sports Club oder Wellhub.

  • Regelmäßige Team-Events und unternehmensweite Offsites.

As an equal opportunity employer, we proudly welcome applications from people of all races, ethnicities, disability statuses, ages, religions, gender identities, and sexual orientations. We encourage you to apply even if you don't think you meet all of the criteria above but are still interested in the role and our mission. Nobody checks every box, and we're looking for team members who are genuinely excited to join PowerUs! We look forward to receiving your application!

data.title: Senior Manager (m/w/d) - Finance Integration
data.description:
Du möchtest dazu beitragen, aus vielen Gesellschaften eine integrierte, skalierbare und zukunftsfähige Finance-Plattform zu formen? Dann suchen wir genau Dich, zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt als:

Senior Manager (m/w/d) - Finance Integration

Als Senior Manager (m/w/d) - Finance Integration übernimmst Du eine zentrale Rolle beim Aufbau unserer gruppenweiten Finance-Funktion. Du berichtest an unserem VP Finance Operation und arbeitest eng mit unserer Director FP&A, unserem CFO, sowie den Geschäftsführern unserer Tochtergesellschaften zusammen und sorgst dafür, dass gruppenweite Finance-Prozesse, Standards und Projekte erfolgreich umgesetzt werden.

Dabei entwickelst du unsere Finance-Organisation gezielt weiter: Du koordinierst Finance-Projekte, begleitest die Integration neuer Gesellschaften, harmonisierst Prozesse und schaffst die Grundlage für eine skalierbare Finance-Plattform. Dafür brauchen wir deine Unterstützung!


Die Arsipa Gruppe ist eine schnell wachsende, PE-backed Unternehmensgruppe im Bereich Health, Safety & Environment, unterstützt von Warburg Pincus. Mit über 1.000 Mitarbeitenden, 20+ Tochtergesellschaften und 48 Standorten in Deutschland und Österreich bauen wir im Rahmen einer klaren Buy-&-Build-Strategie eine skalierbare Plattform mit nachhaltiger Wertschöpfung. Unser Ziel: eine der führenden Anbieterinnen im deutschsprachigen Markt - unterstützt durch zentrale Funktionen wie Finance, HR, Marketing und IT am Standort Berlin.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Finance Integration & Projektmanagement:

    • Management der Finanzintegration neuer Tochtergesellschaften im Rahmen unserer Buy-&-Build-Strategie.

    • Steuerung und Koordination gruppenweiter Finance-Projekte und Integrationsinitiativen.

    • Begleitung unserer Tochtergesellschaften bei der Einführung und Umsetzung gruppenweiter Finance-Prozesse, Standards und Systeme

    • Nachverfolgung von Maßnahmen, Sicherstellung der Projektfortschritte sowie aktives Eskalationsmanagement.

data.title: Werkstudent (m/w/d) Strategy & Business Development (AI-Taskforce)
data.description:
Deine Mission

Alle reden über AI. Wir entscheiden, wie sie im Unternehmen wirklich eingesetzt wird.
Ein 400-Milliarden-Dollar-Markt. Ein profitables Scale-up, das ihn mit AI und einem globalen Freelancer-Netzwerk neu denkt. Und mittendrin ein Team, das nicht primär Code schreibt, sondern entscheidet, was AI im Unternehmen bewirken soll - für mehr als 25.000 Talents in über 70 Ländern, durch Automatisierung und intelligente Prozesse.

Wir suchen dich als Werkstudent (m/w/d) Strategy & Business Development (AI-Taskforce) in unserem Headquarter in München-Schwabing für unsere cross-funktionale strategische Taskforce. Du arbeitest an der Schnittstelle von Strategy, Business und AI - als Sparringspartner:in für AI Engineers, Product- und Operations-Expert:innen sowie eine ehemalige BCG-Beraterin. Nicht als zusätzliche:r Engineer im Team, sondern als die Person, die dafür sorgt, dass das Team das Richtige baut.
Das ist keine klassische Werkstudentenstelle für Techies. Du strukturierst Probleme, baust Business Cases, bewertest AI-Anwendungen aus Business-Perspektive und übersetzt zwischen dem, was technisch möglich ist, und dem, was strategisch sinnvoll ist. Die Konzepte, an denen du arbeitest, landen nicht in einer Schublade - sie fließen direkt in Entscheidungen unseres Leadership-Teams ein.

Was du wirklich machst

  • AI-Strategie statt AI-Code: Du arbeitest an strategischen AI-Initiativen wie unserem Talent Assistant oder AutoQA 2.0 (KI-basierte Voice-File-Analyse) mit - nicht als Entwickler:in, sondern als jemand, der Anforderungen strukturiert, Prioritäten setzt und aus ersten Ideen belastbare Feature-Konzepte macht. Die technische Umsetzung übernehmen unsere AI Engineers; du sorgst dafür, dass sie das Richtige bauen.
  • Aus Ideen werden Entscheidungen: Du analysierst komplexe Fragestellungen, baust Business Cases nach klassischer Case-Logik auf und entwickelst Entscheidungsgrundlagen für unser Leadership-Team. Deine Analysen beeinflussen unmittelbar, welche AI-Initiativen umgesetzt werden.
  • AI braucht Struktur: Große Sprachmodelle sind nur so gut wie die Daten dahinter. Du definierst Kompetenzframeworks und Bewertungslogiken, die unsere AI-Systeme intelligenter machen - die inhaltliche Logik, nicht die technische Implementierung.
  • Eigene Projekte mit echtem Ownership: Du übernimmst eigenständig Themen von der ersten Analyse bis zum ersten Konzept - ein neuer AI-Use-Case, ein Workflow, der heute noch manuell läuft, eine Automatisierung, ein neuer Lösungsansatz. Der Inhalt wechselt, der Anspruch nicht: Du bekommst Verantwortung, nicht nur Aufgaben.
  • Dort arbeiten, wo gerade der größte Hebel liegt: Du unterstützt unser Team dort, wo aktuell die spannendsten strategischen Fragestellungen entstehen. Das bedeutet Abwechslung, hohe Geschwindigkeit und sichtbaren Impact.
Warum diese Rolle dich außergewöhnlich schnell wachsen lässt

Hier lernst du nicht programmieren - du lernst, wie man AI-Investitionen bewertet, Business Cases baut, die vor Geschäftsführung und Leadership bestehen, und komplexe Themen so strukturiert, dass daraus messbarer Business Impact entsteht. Genau das Handwerk, das du später in der Strategieberatung oder im Corporate Strategy-Umfeld brauchst - nur, dass die Empfehlung hier real umgesetzt wird und nicht in einer Präsentation endet.
Du arbeitest eng mit einer ehemaligen BCG-Beraterin sowie AI Engineers und Product-Expert:innen zusammen und bewegst dich täglich zwischen Strategie, Business Judgement und AI.
Die letzte Werkstudentin ist anschließend als Trainee bei uns eingestiegen - nicht, weil wir es versprechen, sondern weil sie während ihrer Zeit bei uns bereits Verantwortung übernommen hat.


Dein Skillset

  • Akademischer Hintergrund: Du studierst aktuell im Master (BWL, VWL, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen oder vergleichbar) und bringst bereits erste praktische Erfahrung mit - idealerweise mit strategischem oder analytischem Fokus.
  • AI-affin, kein AI Engineer: Du musst nicht coden können und keine Modelle bauen. Aber du nutzt AI-Tools wie Claude oder ChatGPT als Power-User für Recherche, Analyse und Strukturierung - und verstehst, wie AI Geschäftsprozesse verändert. Wichtiger als technisches Tiefenwissen: Du erkennst, welches Problem ein AI-Use-Case eigentlich lösen soll.
  • Fähigkeiten: Du strukturierst komplexe Sachverhalte sauber und nutzt PowerPoint und Excel sicher genug, um überzeugende Management-Präsentationen und Business Cases aufzubereiten.
  • Mindset: Du wartest nicht darauf, dass dir jemand den nächsten Schritt erklärt. Du arbeitest dich gerne in neue Themen ein, denkst unternehmerisch und willst Lösungen entwickeln statt Aufgaben abzuarbeiten.
  • Sprachkenntnisse: Du kommunizierst und präsentierst in verhandlungssicherem Deutsch und Englisch und verfügst natürlich über eine gesunde Portion Humor.
  • Rahmenbedingungen: Du hast 16–20 Stunden pro Woche während des Semesters Kapazität, bei uns vor Ort im Münchner Headquarter tätig zu sein. In der vorlesungsfreien Zeit flexibel bis Vollzeit möglich.


Dein Winning Deal

  • Deine Chance: Vom ersten Tag an arbeitest du an einer der strategisch wichtigsten AI-Initiativen unseres Unternehmens mit und gestaltest Lösungen, die den Arbeitsalltag tausender Menschen verbessern können.
  • Dein Buddy: Enge Zusammenarbeit mit einer ehemaligen BCG-Beraterin, die dich individuell begleitet und fordert.
  • Dein Netzwerk: Tägliche Zusammenarbeit mit AI Engineers, Product-, Strategy- und Operations-Expert:innen - Einblicke, die klassische Werkstudentenstellen selten bieten.
  • Deine Perspektive: Ein anschließender Einstieg als Trainee ist ausdrücklich möglich und in unserem Team bereits mehrfach Realität geworden. 
  • Deine Benefits:Neben weekly Pizza und Snacks vor Ort, bieten wir dir außerdem einen Joblunch-Zuschuss (4 x 6,90 € im Monat), eine bezuschusste Wellpass-Mitgliedschaft, Rabatte via "Corporate Benefits" sowie grandiose Team- und Companyevents.
  • Dein Arbeitsplatz: Flexibles, hybrides Arbeitsmodell in einem unserer modernen, hundefreundlichen Büros.
  • Dein Beitrag: Eine Position in einem profitablen Unternehmen, in dem du die Freiheit und das Vertrauen hast, mitzugestalten und mit uns an der „Future of Work" zu arbeiten.
  • Unsere Werte: Eine offene, authentische Kultur und ein leistungsstarkes, humorvolles Team, das sich darauf freut, gemeinsam mit dir mutige Entscheidungen zu treffen und neue Wege zu gehen.

data.title: Platform & DevOps Engineer (m/w/d)
data.description:
Deine Mission

Skalierung braucht ein Fundament, das mitwächst. Über unsere Plattform laufen täglich Interaktionen von mehr als 25.000 Talents in 70+ Ländern, und mit unserem Wachstumsziel von 500 Mio. € Umsatz bis 2030 steigt der Anspruch an unsere Cloud-Platform, Deployment-Prozesse und Kosteneffizienz kontinuierlich.

Als Platform & DevOps Engineer (m/w/d) im hybriden Modell an einem unserer Standorte in München, Berlin oder Halle (Saale) verantwortest du unsere Cloud Platform, primär auf Microsoft Azure. Du entscheidest, wie wir Infrastruktur designen, betreiben und optimieren, mit klarem Fokus auf Skalierbarkeit, Zuverlässigkeit und Kosteneffizienz. Gleichzeitig gestaltest du unsere CI/CD-Plattform und Self-Service-Tools weiter, die unseren Engineering-Teams schnelleres und sichereres Deployment ermöglichen. 

Deine Aufgaben
Cloud Platform & Developer Enablement

  • Azure Platform Ownership: Du verantwortest Design, Betrieb und Weiterentwicklung unserer Cloud-Infrastruktur, von Compute und Networking bis Identity und Governance.
  • Infrastructure as Code statt Klick-Administration: Du entwickelst und pflegst IaC mit Terraform, stellst wiederverwendbare Module bereit und automatisierst, was manuell fehleranfällig wäre.
  • CI/CD-Plattform kontinuierlich weiterentwickeln: Du automatisierst Deployments über den gesamten Software-Lifecycle und baust Self-Service-Plattformen, die Dev-Teams eigenständiger machen.
  • Developer Experience mitdenken: Du arbeitest eng mit Engineering und Product zusammen, um Delivery-Prozesse und Plattform-Fähigkeiten laufend zu verbessern.
Platform Reliability, Security & Cost Efficiency
  • Platform Reliability im Blick: Du monitorst Performance, Verfügbarkeit und Stabilität und gehst Infrastruktur- und Deployment-Probleme proaktiv an, bevor sie zum Incident werden.
  • Security by Design: Gemeinsam mit unserem CISO-Team integrierst du Security Controls direkt in Plattform und CI/CD-Prozesse, inklusive Azure Security Services, Policies und Benchmarks.
  • Kosteneffizienz als Designprinzip: Du optimierst Infrastruktur und Deployment-Plattformen konsequent auf Skalierbarkeit, Performance und Kosten, von Anfang an statt nachträglich.
  • FinOps in der Praxis: Du baust Cloud-Cost-Monitoring, Budgeting und Forecasting auf und lieferst konkrete Empfehlungen zur laufenden Kostenoptimierung.


Dein Skillset

  • Cloud Platform: Hands-on-Erfahrung mit Microsoft Azure in Compute, Networking, Storage, Identity und Governance, plus Verständnis von Cloud-Architektur-Prinzipien auch über Azure hinaus.
  • Automation: Routiniert mit Terraform, Bicep oder ARM, CI/CD-Pipelines mit GitLab CI/CD oder vergleichbaren Tools produktiv aufgebaut, Configuration Management automatisiert statt manuell gepflegt.
  • Container & Scripting: Erfahrung mit Docker und Kubernetes/Nomad oder Azure ACA/ACI, sichere Scripting-Skills in Python, PowerShell oder Bash.
  • Observability & Security: Monitoring, Logging und Alerting im Alltag, angewandtes Verständnis von IAM, RBAC, Zero Trust und Privileged Identity Management, praktische Erfahrung mit GDPR, ISO 27001, SOC 2 oder PCI DSS.
  • FinOps: Cloud-Usage-Analyse, Ressourcenoptimierung und kosteneffiziente Architekturen als Teil deines Designs, nicht als Nachgedanke. Azure-Zertifizierungen, FinOps-Frameworks, Serverless-Architekturen oder Erfahrung mit verteilten oder hybriden Systemen sind ein Plus.
  • Arbeitsweise: Analytisches, lösungsorientiertes Denken, Eigenverantwortung im interdisziplinären Umfeld, klare Kommunikation mit technischen wie nichttechnischen Stakeholdern, fließendes Englisch und eine gesunde Portion Humor.


Dein Winning Deal

  • Die Werte: Wir punkten mit einer offenen, authentischen Kultur und einem leistungsstarken sowie humorvollen Team, das sich schon jetzt darauf freut, mit dir mutige Entscheidungen zu treffen und neue Wege zu gehen, die uns zu nachhaltigen Erfolgen führen.
  • Dein Footprint: Eine Position in einer profitablen Company, in der deine Infrastruktur-Entscheidungen direkten Einfluss auf Skalierung und Kosten haben, nicht nur auf dem Papier.
  • Deine Chance: Bei uns hast du vom ersten Tag an die Möglichkeit, Verantwortung zu übernehmen, Innovationen voranzutreiben und gemeinsam mit einem Team aus Expert:innen das Unternehmen und dich weiterzuentwickeln.
  • Deine Benefits: Neben 30 Tagen Urlaub bieten wir dir außerdem einen "Joblunch"-Zuschuss (69 € im Monat), eine "Givve"-Card (wird monatlich mit 50 € aufgeladen) oder alternativ eine bezuschusste "Wellpass" Mitgliedschaft, Rabatte via "Corporate Benefits", die Möglichkeit eines "JobRad"-Leasings, Zuschüsse zur Altersvorsorge (bAV & VL) sowie grandiose Team- und Companyevents.
  • Dein Arbeitsplatz: Bei uns arbeitest du im flexiblen, hybriden Modell aus einem unserer hundefreundlichen und modernen Offices und hast zudem die Möglichkeit auf 2 Wochen im Jahr Workation innerhalb der EU (*gilt nur für Mitarbeiter:innen mit EU-Pass).

Das erwartet Dich

Als Product Manager (m/w/d) verantwortest Du die Anbindung von DocuWare an Netzwerke zum Austausch von e-Invoices in Zusammenarbeit mit Engineering-, UX- und Compliance-Spezialisten. Gemeinsam stellt Ihr sicher, dass DocuWare die Anforderungen unserer Kunden an den Austausch von elektronischen Rechnungen erfüllt. Dabei behältst Du die regulatorischen Anforderungen und Zeitpläne im Blick und hilfst unseren Kunden, diese mit DocuWare zu erfüllen. 

Du kannst dich in die Lage unserer Anwenderinnen und Anwender versetzen und ihre Probleme und täglichen Aufgaben nachvollziehen? Du bist neugierig, arbeitest gerne lösungsorientiert und im Team, übernimmst gerne Verantwortung und bist ein Organisationstalent? Dann freuen wir uns darauf, Dich kennen zu lernen! 
Zu Deinen Aufgaben gehören:

  • Du verfolgst die Entwicklungen und Anforderungen für e-Invoicing in und außerhalb Europa in Zusammenarbeit mit externen und internen Compliance-Spezialisten.
  • Du entwickelst ein tiefes Verständnis für die Anforderungen und Bedürfnisse unserer Kunden.
  • Du agierst dabei kundenzentriert, holst Kundenfeedback ein und analysierst Daten, um die richtigen Entscheidungen abzuleiten.
  • Du formulierst präzise Anforderung zu den Kundenproblemen und -bedürfnissen.
  • Du entwirfst die kurz-, mittel- und langfristige Strategie und Roadmap für Deinen Bereich unseres Produkts und führst das Team mit Zielen und KPIs.
  • Du prägst eine konstruktive und integrative Zusammenarbeit innerhalb der Produktteams und agierst als Teamschnittstelle zu Stakeholdern.
  • Du arbeitest eng mit Softwareentwicklern und UX-Spezialisten an der Implementierung des Produktes im Rahmen des SCRUM-Frameworks zusammen.


Das bringst Du mit

  • Du verfügst über breites und tiefes Wissen im Bereich e-Invoicing.
  • Die Begriffe XRechnung, ZUGFeRD, FatturaPA und Factur-X sind für Dich keine Unbekannten.
  • Du kannst die Unterschiede zwischen PEPPOL, SDI, Chorus Pro und FACe in wenigen Worten verständlich erklären.
  • Du hast Erfahrung als Produktmanager für Software-Produkte. Erfahrung mit B2B Software ist ein Plus.
  • Erfahrung in der Arbeit in einem agilen Umfeld (beispielsweise als SCRUM Product Owner).
  • Du hast Freude am direkten Kontakt mit Endnutzern und der Lösungsgestaltung anhand deren Bedürfnissen.
  • Du verfügst über ausgeprägte organisatorische Fähigkeiten, arbeitest zielorientiert und übernimmst gerne Verantwortung.
  • Du verfügst über ausgezeichnete verbale und schriftliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten, um komplexe Sachverhalte verständlich darzulegen.
  • Eine Hohe soziale Kompetenz und Teamfähigkeit zeichnen Dich aus.
  • Fließende Englischkenntnisse, Deutschkenntnisse sind ein Plus.


Darauf kannst Du Dich freuen

Es gibt viele gute Gründe für DocuWare – unsere Unternehmenskultur ist nur einer davon.

data.title: Senior Applied AI Engineer (f/m/d)
data.description:
Who is Sonar?

Sonar is driving the future of agent-centric software development. As the leader in AI code verification and governance, we solve a critical problem: ensuring that software generated by AI-assisted developers or autonomous agents is reliable, secure, and maintainable.

Integrating seamlessly with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Gemini, and Devin, we help over 75% of the Fortune 100 build trusted, reliable, compliant software. Customers who use Sonar are 44% less likely to report an outage due to AI-generated code.

We believe code verification is the critical missing link in the Agent-Centric Development Cycle (AC/DC). Industry giants like Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com, Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company count on us to provide independent, explainable, consistent review and governance of their AI-generated code via products like:

  • SonarQube: The world’s leading AI code review and verification platform.
  • SonarQube Foundation Agent: Currently topping the leaderboards for agentic software repair.
  • SonarSweep & Sonar Context Augmentation: Providing the enterprise-grade context and constraints agents need to be truly effective.

Our team operates across global hubs in Austin, Bochum, Dubai, Geneva, London, Singapore, Tokyo, and Washington D.C. We move with a mindset we call CODE:

  • Committed to our customers and community.
  • Obsessed with quality.
  • Deliberate in our decisions.
  • Effective as one team.

With over $400M in revenue and profitable, fast-paced growth, we are building the backbone of the AI software revolution. If you’re hungry to have an impact, want to build at a fast pace, and ready to work at the forefront of AI, we want to hear from you.


Position description

 
SonarSource is looking for a passionate AI Engineer who will be a driving force in our internal operations. You will play a central role in Sonar's AI transformation, applying your expertise to solve internal business operation problems, automate complex processes, and amplify productivity across departments using cutting-edge AI agents and full-stack tools. Your work will directly enhance our operational efficiency and strategic agility.

What you will do
  • Design & Develop: Architect and implement end-to-end AI Agents and full-stack applications that automate complex business processes.
  • Foundational Engineering: Build and maintain the core AI tech stack, including agent orchestration frameworks, vector database integrations, and RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) pipelines.
  • Cloud Orchestration: Oversee the deployment and management of scalable AI services, selecting and adapting infrastructure to meet stringent requirements for high availability, performance, and efficiency.
  • Strategic Transformation: Act as a key contributor to Sonar’s AI transformation, identifying high-impact opportunities for agentic automation across different departments.
  • Governance & Ethics: Collaborate with cross-functional teams to establish governance, security protocols, and best practices for AI development and data privacy.
  • Full-Stack Ownership: Manage the entire lifecycle of internal tools, from backend logic and LLM prompt engineering to intuitive frontend interfaces for internal users.
  • Mentorship: Guide junior engineers and contribute to a culture of technical excellence in AI and automation.

    • Experience and qualifications
  • Full-Stack Expertise: 10+ years of professional experience in full-stack development (e.g., Python, Node.js, React, or similar modern stacks).
  • AI Agent Mastery: Proven experience developing and deploying autonomous AI Agents using frameworks such as LangChain, AutoGen, CrewAI, or similar.
  • Automation Roots: A strong background in traditional automation development (e.g., scripting, workflow engines, or RPA) prior to the LLM era, demonstrating a deep understanding of logic-based systems.
  • Cloud Proficiency: Hands-on experience architecting and deploying production-grade applications on any major cloud platform (AWS experience is highly recommended).
  • Architectural Vision: Deep understanding of the specific architectures required for agentic workflows, including state management, tool-calling, and memory systems.
  • Data & AI Skills: Experience with vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, Weaviate), fine-tuning (optional but preferred), and advanced prompt engineering.
  • Collaborative Mindset: Ability to work with non-technical stakeholders to define governance and translate business needs into technical requirements.
  • Growth Mindset: A passion for staying at the forefront of AI research and a desire to continuously evolve your skill set.
    •  

    Salary range

    Additional comments

    This role is based in Bochum. We are unable to consider candidates unwilling to be in Bochum, but we are willing to relocate the right candidate.


    In-office culture

    We're intentional about this. We believe the best teams are built in the room together. Three anchor days — Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays — create the collaboration rhythm that makes a hub office worth having. 

    Candidates need to be genuinely based in the location the role is posted  — if that's not where you are today, we're happy to support relocation for the right person.

     

    We value diversity, equity, and inclusion

    At Sonar, we believe that our diversity is our strength. We are a global company that values and respects different backgrounds, perspectives, and cultures. We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment where everyone feels valued and empowered to contribute their best. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and welcome all qualified applicants, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

    If you need any accommodation, please reach out to us at All offers of employment at Sonar are contingent upon the results of a comprehensive background check and reference verification conducted before the start date. 

    Applications that are submitted through agencies or third party recruiters will not be considered.

data.title: UVC Partners: Junior Value Creation Analyst - Intern or Working Student (f/m/d)
data.description:
Über uns

UVC Partners backs Europe’s most ambitious B2B tech founders building new category leaders with more than
€800m in assets under management. From DeepTech to AI, the firm has invested in breakout startups including
Isar Aerospace, Proxima Fusion, Q.ANT, Aleph Alpha, Tacto, Flix, and FINN. UVC Partners' Value Creation team is a team of experts whose core mission is to create measurable impact for our portfolio companies by giving them unique access to industry leaders through a structured, proactive approach. Deeply rooted in UnternehmerTUM, Europe's leading startup and business innovation ecosystem, the team builds actionable relationships between our portfolio companies and a network of 1,000+ corporates as potential customers and strategic partners - and turns those relationships into real business outcomes.


Deine Aufgaben

Value Creation is not a side show at UVC Partners. We are looking for an outstanding individual to join us to work within our Value Creation team to open doors for our startups they couldn’t open alone. What you will contribute, starting in week two:

  • Sales Enablement – You will support our founders directly with business development topics. You research who holds the budget inside a target corporate, find the path there through our network, and write the intro email
  • Corporate Partnerships – You prepare sessions with our industrial partners, join the room, and document what comes out of them. You will be talking to people twenty years your senior
  • Knowledge Management – Our founders ask the same questions again and again (pricing, first sales hires, KPI reporting). You own your own topic streams and turn them into something a founder can apply in ten minutes
  • Data Management – Our Salesforce is the memory of the fund. You keep it clean and build the analyses and AI-supported workflows that save the team hours with Claude and Notion

How to apply:
Please apply by uploading your CV, transcripts, and one page of max. 350 words answering all three questions below:
1. Pick one of our portfolio companies and name a concrete target customer for them. Which company, which role inside it, and how would you get to that person? Three or four sentences are enough.
2. Which technological development interests you most right now – and what speaks against it? We want the counterargument as much as the enthusiasm.
3. Which book would you give a founder in their first month, and why? No obligatory business classics. An honest answer beats an impressive one.

Write it yourself. If you used AI, tell us in one sentence what for.


Dein Profil

  • You are currently enrolled in a Master's degree program with excellent results at a top-tier university - We are open to all types of educational backgrounds (e.g., engineering, science, business, finance, etc.)
  • You have previously worked in a fast-paced environment (startups, VC/PE, consulting, or similar)
  • You bring hands-on experience with AI tools; first experience working with Salesforce is also a plus
  • You are deeply passionate about startups, technology, and innovation
  • You are collaborative, empathetic, and communicative - a true team player
  • You have a high level of intellectual curiosity as well as a self-starter and growth mindset
  • Strong written and oral communication skills in English and German
  • You are available for this position either full-time for 5–6 months or part-time (20h/week) for at least 12 months


Deine Vorteile

  • Ownership – You will work on your own impactful projects from day one to contribute to the growth and success of our portfolio companies
  • Important member of the team – You will be part of the Value Creation team where you will get direct access to our outstanding founders
  • Mentorship – Be paired with one senior member of our team with regular 1-to-1 sessions
  • Venture Capital trainee program – Take part in the condensed apprenticeship program that gives you the details on how to excel in the venture capital industry – as an investor or a founder
  • Free sports classes – Join our weekly, free of charge classes in the office in Munich 
  • Network – Be part of the UnternehmerTUM ecosystem to equip you with perspectives and contacts to leapfrog your startup career
  • Sustainability – Get to know the next generation of sustainable startups that are changing the world we live in
  • Competitive salary – You receive a competitive salary package and will have the flexibility to align your studies with our day-to-day operations


Vielfalt ist uns wichtig

Diversity enriches our team. We explicitly encourage all qualified individuals to apply, regardless of gender, social and ethnic background, sexual orientation, religion, age, or disability.


Kontakt

Unternehmertum Venture Capital Partners GmbH , c/o Munich Urban Colab, Freddie- Mercury-Straße 5, 80797 Munich, Germany

www.uvcpartners.com

UVC Partners is an equal opportunity employer.

UVC Partners is an independent venture capital fund. For efficiency, we use certain shared services from UnternehmerTUM. This is why parts of the application process may appear UTUM-branded, and your application will be processed by UVC Partners and UnternehmerTUM.

data.title: Senior Solution Consultant (Pre-Sales) - DACH
data.description:
AMPECO is one of the most innovative companies in the area of electric vehicle charging infrastructure – an industry that aims to change the world by making charging easier for everyone. As electric vehicles (EVs) are bringing in a transformation of our transport and mobility sectors, AMPECO is at the forefront of a grand revolution and we’re just getting started.

Our product – the AMPECO EV Charging Platform is a business-critical SaaS platform used by companies to manage their electric vehicle charging infrastructure, processes and energy use. It’s already in use by companies in more than 70 countries — across North and South America, Europe, Africa, Asia and Australia.

Our team is highly motivated, capable, and committed to our mission — and our growth is backed by world-class investors, including BMW i Ventures, the mobility-focused venture-capital arm of the BMW Group. We are looking to expand the team with like-minded capable people, eager to give, learn and grow together with us.

About the role

AMPECO is expanding across the DACH region, and we’re looking for a Germany-based Senior Solution Consultant - responsible for pre-sales across Germany, Austria, and Switzerland - to help drive that growth. This is a senior, individual-contributor role for someone who combines deep product and industry expertise with the interpersonal range to win the confidence of technical and business stakeholders alike.

You will be the solutioning counterpart to our DACH Business Development Manager - the two of you working as a close-knit team on the region’s most important opportunities. While the BDM leads the commercial relationship, you own the solution end to end: mapping each prospect’s business needs to AMPECO’s platform, leading demonstrations and Proof-of-Concept engagements, owning bid management for DACH opportunities — from RFx and tenders through to the supporting business case — and making the complex feel clear for everyone in the room.

You won’t be doing this alone. You’ll be enabled by an established Solution Consulting team, with proven tools, practices, and methodologies behind you — so you can put your energy into the deals in front of you. AMPECO already powers some of the most prominent Charge Point Operators in the DACH region and is in active conversations with many of the rest, so you’ll be joining at a moment of real momentum and clear opportunity to expand. As we continue to grow across Germany and the wider region, the impact you make here will be significant — with room to grow alongside it.

If you thrive in fast-paced, complex enterprise environments, enjoy working with highly driven teams, and want to play a pivotal role in the energy transition in one of Europe’s most important EV markets, this role is for you.


Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain in-depth knowledge of AMPECO’s platform and the e-mobility industry, with a strong grasp of the DACH market and its requirements;

  • Act as the solutioning lead on strategic DACH opportunities, working hand in hand with the DACH Business Development Manager to map each prospect’s business needs to AMPECO’s capabilities;

  • Drive Proof-of-Concept engagements with prospective clients, ensuring the business drivers are sound, relevant, and build a compelling case to advance the opportunity;

  • Design and deliver effective demonstrations that connect AMPECO’s solution advantages to prospects’ business and technical requirements;

  • Build and maintain trusted relationships with the key stakeholders involved in DACH deals, becoming a credible advisor throughout the sales cycle;

  • Take an active advisory role during sales cycles, bringing solution expertise and industry best practices to the team;

  • Own bid management for DACH opportunities — taking end-to-end responsibility for RFIs, RFPs, RFQs, and tenders, from structuring and writing the response to coordinating input across teams and managing deadlines;

  • Represent AMPECO at industry events across the region and stay close to market trends, the competitive landscape, and evolving customer needs;

  • Travel across the DACH region as needed for customer engagements, workshops, and events.


    • Your Profile

  • 6+ years of professional experience, including 3+ years in a pre-sales, solution consulting, or similar sales-focused role within enterprise or B2B software;

  • Native-level German and fluent English, both spoken and written — you will work with German-speaking enterprise customers daily;

  • Strong pre-sales execution skills: solution design, demonstrations, Proof-of-Concepts, and bid / RFx management;

  • Tech-savvy and a fast learner on technical topics — comfortable holding technical conversations and explaining how the platform works, without needing to be a deeply technical specialist or engineer;

  • A confident communicator, able to build rapport and credibility with senior business and technical stakeholders and to present complex topics clearly;

  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to structure complex challenges and shape solutions for evolving business models;

  • Strong business acumen — able to articulate customer value and connect AMPECO’s platform to strategic outcomes;

  • Based in Germany, self-driven and well-organised, and comfortable operating effectively in a remote, distributed team across the DACH region;

  • Naturally curious, with a genuine interest in continuously learning about the product and the industry;

  • A collaborative team player who works seamlessly with Sales, Product, and other specialists;

  • Motivated to build a long-term career in the e-mobility sector.


    • Considered an advantage

  • Domain knowledge in mobility, energy, or a related sector;

  • Familiarity with EV charging technology and standards such as OCPP, OCPI, or ISO 15118;

  • Experience working in a SaaS or PaaS environment with long, multi-stakeholder enterprise sales cycles;

  • Background in consulting or professional services;

  • Experience in enterprise sales;

  • Fluency in an additional European language (e.g. French, Italian).


    • What we offer
  • Competitive salary and benefits package;
  • Flexibility to work from anywhere in Germany or from a modern co-working space in Munich's Werksviertel, near Ostbahnhof;
  • Opportunity to grow with a mission-driven startup in a high-impact industry.
    • Our team at AMPECO is deeply committed to our mission and we're looking for like-minded individuals eager to give, learn and grow with us. If you're passionate about innovative technology and want to make a real impact in the e-mobility sector, we want to hear from you. Join AMPECO in building the future of EV charging!

data.title: Kalkulator:in Ladeinfrastruktur & Energieinfrastruktur (m/w/d)
data.description:
nanuq elektrifiziert den Schwerlast- und Flottenverkehr. Wir planen, bauen und betreiben Ladeinfrastruktur für Logistik- und Speditionsunternehmen, vom Depot mit vier Ladepunkten bis zum Ladepark mit Megawattanschluss. Dazu kommen Photovoltaik und Batteriespeicher, gesteuert über unsere eigene Softwareplattform arctiqOS. Unser Modell: Truck Charging as a Service. Der Kunde bekommt eine funktionierende Ladeinfrastruktur, wir übernehmen Planung, Bau, Betrieb und Finanzierung.

Wir wachsen schnell, und mit uns die Zahl und Größe der Projekte. Deshalb suchen wir jemanden, der unsere Angebote und Projekte sauber durchrechnet, bevor sie rausgehen.

Aufgaben

  • Du kalkulierst unsere Projekte von der ersten Grobeinschätzung im Vertrieb bis zum verbindlichen Angebot: Tiefbau, Elektrotechnik, Netzanschluss, Hardware, Montage, Inbetriebnahme
  • Du erstellst Massenermittlungen und Leistungsverzeichnisse auf Basis von Lageplänen, Netzanschlussauskünften und Bedarfsermittlungen
  • Du holst Nachunternehmer- und Lieferantenangebote ein, vergleichst sie und arbeitest sie in die Kalkulation ein
  • Du kalkulierst die Betreibermodelle mit: Investitionskosten, Betriebskosten über die Laufzeit, Ladepreise und Wirtschaftlichkeit für Kunde und für uns
  • Du pflegst und entwickelst unsere Kalkulationsgrundlagen weiter, also Preisspiegel, Aufwandswerte, Kostenkennwerte, und sorgst dafür, dass sie aktuell bleiben
  • Du kalkulierst Nachträge und Änderungen während der Projektabwicklung
  • Du arbeitest eng mit Vertrieb, Projektabwicklung und Einkauf zusammen und bist die Instanz, die sagt, ob eine Zahl trägt
  • Nach der Umsetzung schaust du dir Soll und Ist an und ziehst daraus die Lehren für die nächste Kalkulation

Qualifikation

  • Abgeschlossene Ausbildung oder Studium im Bereich Elektrotechnik, Bauingenieurwesen, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen, Versorgungstechnik oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation
  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Kalkulation von Bau- oder Elektroprojekten, gerne aus dem Anlagenbau, Elektrohandwerk, Tiefbau, der Energiewirtschaft oder von einem Generalunternehmer
  • Sicherer Umgang mit Leistungsverzeichnissen, Massenermittlung und VOB
  • Du bist fit in Excel und arbeitest dich schnell in neue Tools ein, bei uns unter anderem Odoo und Reonic
  • Du denkst unternehmerisch und weißt, dass eine Kalkulation nicht nur richtig, sondern auch verkaufbar sein muss
  • Du arbeitest strukturiert und sauber, auch wenn drei Angebote gleichzeitig raus müssen
  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse, gute Englischkenntnisse für den Austausch mit Herstellern und Lieferanten

Schön, aber kein Muss

  • Erfahrung mit Ladeinfrastruktur, Photovoltaik oder Batteriespeichern
  • Kenntnisse rund um Netzanschlüsse, TAB und Anmeldeprozesse beim Netzbetreiber
  • Erfahrung mit Förderprogrammen für Ladeinfrastruktur
  • Erfahrung mit Betreiber- oder Contractingmodellen

Benefits

  • Eine Position mit direktem Einfluss auf die Zahlen des Unternehmens, kurze Wege zur Geschäftsführung
  • Ein Thema mit Rückenwind: die Elektrifizierung des Schwerlastverkehrs steht am Anfang, du gestaltest sie mit
  • Viel Gestaltungsspielraum beim Aufbau unserer Kalkulationsprozesse, statt in fertige Strukturen einzurücken
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten und mobiles Arbeiten
  • Ein Team, das lieber pragmatisch löst als lange abstimmt

Klingt nach dir?

Dann schick uns deinen Lebenslauf. Ein Anschreiben brauchen wir nicht, ein paar Sätze zu deinen bisherigen Projekten reichen uns völlig.

data.description:
Build the product engine behind the next generation of MedTech software.

REMATIQ is building AI software that helps life sciences and medical device companies bring products to market faster, without compromising the quality, traceability and compliance their industry demands.

We work with leading companies including Philips, Siemens Healthineers, B. Braun and Novartis, and have recently closed our Series A.

Now we’re looking for a hands-on Product Lead / Head of Product to help us turn ambitious product direction into exceptional shipped product.

The role

This is a player-coach role for someone who wants real product ownership without moving away from the product itself.

Our founder will continue to lead long-term product strategy, major capability bets and the frontier of where REMATIQ should go.

You will own how we get there.

You’ll take responsibility for the full product execution loop:

Customer insight → product ideas → prioritization → definition → engineering refinement → sprint execution → shipped product → learning.

You’ll lead a growing team of 2–3 Product Managers, raise the quality bar across the product organization, and still directly own one or two of our most important and complex product areas yourself.

You won’t be managing the process from the sidelines. You’ll be in the details with customers, PMs, engineers and designers, making decisions and helping the team ship.

What you’ll do

  • Own product execution end to end: Turn strategic direction and customer insight into clear priorities, well-defined product work and shipped outcomes.

  • Lead and develop the Product team: Manage 2–3 PMs, help them sharpen their judgment and execution, and establish a consistently high bar for product work.

  • Stay hands-on: Personally lead discovery, define product requirements, make prioritization decisions and own some of our hardest product areas.

  • Run product across multiple squads: Create clarity across Product, Engineering and Design and ensure teams move from idea to execution without unnecessary process or ambiguity.

  • Make the hard calls: Navigate competing customer needs, technical constraints and incomplete information, and make clear product decisions rather than simply facilitating consensus.

  • Build an AI-native product organization: Use AI deeply in your own work and help rethink how discovery, specification, prototyping, analysis and product development should work in an AI-first company.

  • Stay close to customers: Understand how sophisticated enterprise teams actually work, identify the problems worth solving and turn customer insight into scalable product rather than one-off features.

  • Continuously improve how we build: Identify where our product process needs more structure, where it needs less, and build the operating rhythm that helps REMATIQ ship better and faster as we scale.

What we’re looking for

You may be a strong fit if you:

  • Have led product for a B2B enterprise software product.

  • Have directly managed at least 2 Product Managers.

  • Are still deeply hands-on and comfortable running discovery, writing and refining product requirements, prioritizing trade-offs and working closely with Engineering.

  • Have owned product delivery across multiple squads or product areas.

  • Have strong product judgment and are comfortable making decisions with incomplete information.

  • Are genuinely AI-forward: you actively use AI in your work, understand how it changes product development, and have thoughtful views on what makes a product truly AI-native.

  • Communicate exceptionally well, both in writing and in conversation.

  • Operate with high ownership, pace and reliability.

We’ll be especially excited if you

  • Have been a founder, founding PM or very early product leader and can demonstrate founder-like ownership.

  • Are technically strong enough to work deeply with engineers on APIs, data, AI systems, workflows and technical trade-offs.

  • Learned product craft inside an excellent product organization with a high bar for execution.

  • Have experienced both sides of the journey: building product in an early-stage environment and later helping a product organization scale.

Why REMATIQ?

  • A rare product moment: We have enterprise customers, strong demand and fresh Series A funding, while many of the product systems and ways of working for our next stage are still yours to shape.

  • Real product ownership: You’ll have genuine authority over prioritization, product definition and execution, while staying close enough to the work to personally influence what gets built.

  • Player-coach by design: This isn’t a role where leadership means leaving product craft behind. You’ll build the team while continuing to own meaningful product problems yourself.

  • AI is the product and the way we work: You’ll help define what an AI-native product organization should actually look like, rather than simply adding AI tools to traditional processes.

  • Complex problems worth solving: Our customers operate in environments where workflows are technical, regulated and mission-critical. The product challenges are correspondingly deep.

  • Work directly with the people shaping the company: Partner closely with the founders, Engineering and Design on the decisions that determine what REMATIQ becomes.

  • Meaningful impact: Better software can help medical innovators reduce manual work, navigate complexity and bring important products to market faster and more safely.

  • Compensation and ownership: Competitive salary plus equity, giving you a meaningful stake in the company you’re helping to build.

data.title: Head of Finance and Operations
data.description:
Join REMATIQ in revolutionizing medical innovation.

Join us on our mission to help medical innovators bring life-saving products to market faster and safer.

About REMATIQ

REMATIQ builds AI software for life sciences and medical device companies. Our platform helps teams automate complex documentation and compliance workflows, while keeping outputs traceable, reviewable, and audit-ready.

Product development in MedTech is highly complex: teams need to manage requirements, documentation, quality processes, regulatory expectations, and internal reviews across many systems and stakeholders. REMATIQ helps customers simplify this work, reduce manual effort, and move faster without compromising on quality or compliance.

We work with some of the world’s leading life sciences and MedTech companies, including Philips, Siemens Healthineers, B. Braun, and Novartis. We are backed by exceptional investors, having recently closed a Series A round.

What you’ll do

With high customer demand and fresh investment, our teams are growing quickly. As Head of Finance & Operations, you’ll build the operating backbone for REMATIQ’s next stage of growth. Following our Series A, you’ll work directly with the founders to shape how we plan, allocate resources, hire, operate and scale the company. Finance, HR, Contracting, and Company Operations will initially sit within your function. You’ll build the people, processes, and systems needed to run them well, with individual areas growing into dedicated functions as the company scales.

Concretely, the following falls in the scope of the role:

  • Own financial planning and reporting: Deeply understand both historical and future financial performance and key KPI, proactively report to changes and report to investors and the company.

  • Ensure proper accounting: Closely work with our external accounting firm and internal teams to ensure timely and accurate closing of our books.

  • Oversee HR and People operations: Own the smooth running of core people processes, from payroll and employee administration to performance reviews, recruiting coordination and onboarding, until these areas grow into a dedicated People function.

  • Structure recruiting and onboarding: Work with external and internal recruiters to ensure a great candidate experience and the right quality bar of our talent.

  • Legal, compliance and contracting: Work with our external legal counsel and our suppliers to enforce policies and negotiate offers.

  • Company operations: Coordinate our OKR setting process, office logistics, legal setup, open new entities and everything else which ensures smooth sailing.

What we’re looking for

We’re looking for someone who combines strong financial judgment with the breadth and pragmatism of an early-stage operator. You’ve built before, know which processes need rigor and which need to stay lightweight, and use AI and automation thoughtfully to turn ambiguity into systems that work.

You may be a strong fit if you have:

  • Operations and finance experience: You’ve built the ops and finance function in Series A companies from scratch before, know where to go deep and where to be pragmatic.

  • Excellent problem-solving skills: You are strong at conceptual framing, analysis, synthesis, and turning complex information into clear recommendations.

  • AI-native working style: You actively use AI and automation to eliminate repetitive work, improve decision-making and build internal processes differently from a traditional finance or operations function.

  • Executive communication: Building a clear story with data is second nature to you.

  • Startup mindset: You are adaptable, resilient, hands-on, positive under pressure, and willing to take on challenges beyond a narrow job description.

  • Unquestionable ethics and diligence: We will trust you with all our financial and HR data.

  • Fluency in English, German preferred.

Why join REMATIQ?

  • Rare timing: With strong customer demand and our Series A recently closed, we're entering the stage where the systems that worked for an early team need to become the foundations of a scalable company.

  • Real ownership: Finance, People Operations, contracting and company operations start with you. You won't inherit a mature function; you'll decide what to build, automate, outsource and eventually turn into dedicated teams.

  • Founder access and influence: Work directly with the founders on financial planning, hiring, organisational priorities and the decisions that determine how REMATIQ scales.

  • Purposeful work: Be part of a mission-driven team transforming how medical devices reach the market — in an industry where quality, compliance, and patient safety mean nothing can be left to chance.

  • Compensation & growth: Competitive salary plus equity, giving you a stake in the success you help create.

data.title: Senior ML Ops Engineer
data.description:
KAYAK, part of Booking Holdings (NASDAQ: BKNG), is a leading travel search engine. With billions of queries across our platforms, we help people find their perfect flight, stay, rental car and vacation package. We're also transforming business travel with a new corporate travel solution, KAYAK for Business.

As an employee of KAYAK, you will be part of a travel company that operates a portfolio of global metasearch brands including momondo, Cheapflights and HotelsCombined, among others. From start-up to industry leader, innovation is in our DNA and every employee has an opportunity to make their mark. Our focus is on building the best travel search engine to make it easier for everyone to experience the world.

Every machine learning model KAYAK ships depends on reliable, scalable infrastructure to move from experiment to production — and that's exactly what this role makes possible. KAYAK is seeking a Senior MLOps Engineer who will focus on the design and implementation of our machine learning infrastructure and production lifecycle. This is a senior, hands-on role where you will bridge the gap between data science and production engineering.

You will join the Machine Learning Platform team and be responsible for building and maintaining scalable infrastructure & automated pipelines for model training, deployment, and monitoring, ensuring our ML models are reliable, reproducible, and performant. You will work closely with Data Scientists, ML Engineering and Operations teams to transform experimental code into robust, production-ready services at scale.

This role requires commuting to the Berlin office 3 times a week.

In this role, you will:

  • Build and maintain ML infrastructure end-to-end: Extend and operate the infrastructure that powers every model we ship — including CI/CD pipelines, model orchestration, and automated training pipelines designed to scale reliably without manual intervention.

  • Own model deployment and serving: Help define and evolve the standards and tooling for model serving, ensuring low latency and high availability across our ML services.

  • Develop core MLOps capabilities: Establish and maintain essential infrastructure that functions as reliable, self-service systems for the entire machine learning organization — with a focus on feature stores, model registries, and automated monitoring for performance and data drift.

  • Operationalize infrastructure for the ML team: Collaborate with Operations to enable Kubernetes (k8s) autoscaling and GPU provisioning, turning these into accessible, self-service tools for ML practitioners — including standing up and operating a Kubernetes-based development cluster and taking models from experimentation to GPU-backed production.

  • Improve platform reliability and performance: Partner with Operations to design resilient monitoring using advanced observability tooling. Define service-level objectives and implement automation to reduce manual interventions and improve system reliability.

  • Empower Data Scientists through standardized, optimized workflows: Amplify the impact of the ML team by building clear, well-supported "golden paths" — standardized workflows that streamline the model development lifecycle and let Data Scientists focus on modeling while you handle the infrastructure.

Please apply if you have:

  • Experience building and operating ML platforms in production environments.

  • Solid working knowledge of containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes), Linux internals, and model serving at scale.

  • Familiarity with ML lifecycle tooling, including orchestration frameworks, feature stores, model registries, and drift or performance monitoring.

  • Experience owning production systems: defining service-level objectives (SLOs), building observability (for example, using tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, or Datadog), participating in incident response, and diagnosing large-scale failures systematically. You look for opportunities to automate repetitive work rather than absorb it.

  • Comfort writing production-quality code in Python or a comparable language.

  • Experience modernizing production infrastructure with attention to reliability, risk, and cost — including thoughtful sequencing of work to maintain availability and continuity for live systems.

  • The ability to take ownership of technical outcomes, advocate for decisions using data, and communicate clearly in writing and in person — to both technical and non-technical audiences.

We are looking for a Full-Stack Software Engineer with solid frontend and backend experience to join us remotely or in our Berlin office. As we grow, we need your skills to support our mission of building the future of green search.

Day-to-day, you will work across the entire stack - from crafting intuitive user interfaces to building scalable backend services - ensuring our product remains delightful, reliable, and efficient for millions of daily users.

Want to join a collaborative team, shape a product used by millions, and help regenerate our planet’s ecosystem? Read on!

 

A Role to Help Create Lasting Change

  • Develop Core Product Features: Expand our Accounts Platform (user identity and account management) and develop the Climate Impact Experience through engaging, gamified features like seed tracking, levels, and digital collectibles.

  • End-to-End Ownership: Architect, build, test, and ship features as part of a cross-functional product team alongside Product, Design, and BI partners.

  • Ensure Operational Excellence: Maintain system resilience, security, data privacy, and performance to support our growing user base.

  • Elevate Engineering Culture: Promote engineering best practices, share knowledge, and cultivate a collaborative, high-trust engineering environment.

Your Areas of Knowledge and Experience

  • 3+ years of experience writing and shipping production-grade JavaScript and TypeScript code.

  • 3+ years of experience building and maintaining backend services using Node.js or Go.

  • Experience with Vue.js, React, or other similar frontend libraries.

  • Solid collaboration mindset and experience in cross-functional teams.

  • Professional fluency in English.

Our Tech Stack

You are not expected to have knowledge of everything we do. This is what we currently use:

Backend

  • Node.js (JavaScript and TypeScript)

  • Cloudflare Workers (TypeScript)

  • Go on Kubernetes

Frontend

  • Vue 2 with JavaScript (legacy)

  • Vue 3 and Astro components with TypeScript (under migration)

  • SCSS

Why Ecosia?

What if your job made a real difference in the climate crisis? Join Ecosia and help plant millions of trees where people and ecosystems need them most.

  • We are a diverse team, committed to equality, equity, and inclusion, with members from various backgrounds: sexual orientations, genders, ages, races, ethnicities, nationalities, physical and mental disabilities, family structures, and religions.

  • We offer you the opportunity to balance work with other parts of your life: flexible working hours, 30 vacation days per year (based on a five-day workweek), designated Focus Times, and remote work options. (Note: Not applicable to freelance contracts; different labor laws may apply in other countries.)

  • Our green benefits program - including subsidized public transport cards and bike inspection services - supports your sustainable living choices in Berlin. (Availability may vary by location; not applicable to freelance contracts.)

  • We support your professional growth through learning times, hack days, online and physical libraries, and continuous feedback. (Not applicable to freelance contracts.)

Q&A

How many people work at Ecosia?

About 100! Our departments include Engineering, Product, Marketing, Trees, People, and Operations.

Our eng & product teams work in a cross-functional set-up, forming 7 teams.

Where is Ecosia based, and what kind of work setup do we have?
